scope: Bounded identity-only review: 52 leads, comprising 33 new flagged leads, all 12 normalized original-name collisions, and seven already-enrolled unflagged classics. Accept means identity research is sufficient for a qualified discovery label; it approves no starting rule, portable criterion, edition transfer, or deployment. No BoardGameGeek API, bulk dataset, or page content was fetched; identifiers come from Wikidata CC0 and one observed primary publisher hyperlink. Unknown original collision editions are not relabeled by this review.
method: Read CC0 Wikidata item facts using wbgetentities and saved revisions, then corroborate accepted game/edition identities with original designer, publisher, federation, or association-hosted federation sources. Per-ID edition qualifiers are distinguished from item-wide publication years. Qualified display names prevent merging identical names. Holds retain unresolved ambiguity.
